decisions.statement: Nobody could have settled an observation.
An observation holds only while an agent is in the seat.
One run of an agent in a seat is a seat process.
An agent taking a new seat is a presence start.
An agent leaving a seat is a presence stop.
An agent taking a seat the agent left is a presence resume.
An agent leaving a seat and taking the seat again is a presence restart.
An agent leaving a seat and another agent taking the seat is a presence reset.
An agent leaving a seat without being stopped made an unexpected stop.
A seat states whether an agent is present in the seat.

definition: what a seat has because somebody looked
